question: For German drivers born between 1975 and 1990 who have competed in races at the Sepang International Circuit, calculate the percentage of their lap times that were under 1 minute 45 seconds. Among these drivers, identify the top 3 with the highest percentage and list their full names, date of birth, and the exact percentage value.

prediction.sql:
WITH SepangRaces AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM races AS r
    INNER JOIN circuits AS c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Sepang International Circuit'
),
GermanDrivers AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
           d.XCL_038 AS forename,
           d.XCL_039 AS surname,
           d.XCL_040 AS date_of_birth
    FROM drivers AS d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1975' AND '1990'
),
DriverLapStats AS (
    SELECT gd.driver_id,
           gd.forename,
           gd.surname,
           gd.date_of_birth,
           COUNT(*) AS total_laps,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lt.XCL_048 < 105000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fast_laps
    FROM GermanDrivers AS gd
    INNER JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON gd.driver_id = lt.XCL_044
    INNER JOIN SepangRaces AS sr ON lt.XCL_043 = sr.race_id
    GROUP BY gd.driver_id, gd.forename, gd.surname, gd.date_of_birth
)
SELECT forename,
       surname,
       date_of_birth,
       CAST(fast_laps AS REAL) * 100 / total_laps AS percentage
FROM DriverLapStats
WHERE total_laps > 0
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH parsed_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        d.XCL_034 AS driver_id,
        d.XCL_038 AS first_name,
        d.XCL_039 AS last_name,
        d.XCL_040 AS date_of_birth,
        (CASE WHEN INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') <> INSTR(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1), ':') + INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 ELSE 0 END) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 2 * (INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') = INSTR(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1), ':') + INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':')), INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') - INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + 
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) AS lap_seconds
    FROM drivers d
    INNER JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044
    INNER JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
    INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(d.XCL_040, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1975 AND 1990
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'Sepang International Circuit'
),
driver_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        driver_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        date_of_birth,
        COUNT(*) AS total_laps,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lap_seconds < 105 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fast_laps
    FROM parsed_laps
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT 
    first_name,
    last_name,
    date_of_birth,
    (CAST(fast_laps AS REAL) / total_laps) * 100 AS percentage
FROM driver_stats
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 3
